mechanism_evidence.interpretation: Nitro writes a fresh wall-clock build timestamp into nitro.json during each build. This is a volatile build-time metadata field and explains why byte-identical builds can differ only in nitro.json.

required_before_verified: Do not silently ignore nitro.json byte differences.
Determine whether nitro.json is required deployment artifact metadata or can be deterministically controlled without changing canonical source semantics.
If byte-identical reproducibility remains the contract, stabilize or remove the volatile metadata through a controlled, source-consistent mechanism and re-run two clean builds.

If the contract is intentionally semantic rather than byte-identical, create a separately versioned verification contract that explicitly excludes only the documented volatile field; do not label that result byte-deterministic.
